title: A person missing all three fields
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map {name: $.name, age: $.age, city: $.city}

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map {name: $.name, age: $.age, city: $.city}

explanation.approach: Every field access returns null, so you get an object with all nulls. This is not an error — the output is still valid JSON.
